_doc: THE MELEE SWING of the town (One House; the school, the demo and the no-player sim keep their old blow and read none of this). Read by scripts/sim/melee.gd (the rules: `Melee.read()`), scripts/render/combat_fx.gd (the trail, the hit-stop, the camera's push: `set_melee`, which main.gd gives it in the town only) and, for the swing pose, the pawn drawing (scripts/render/pawn_node.gd / the ANIM work). Keys that start with an underscore are notes. A key that is missing keeps the number of Melee.DEFAULTS. THE SWING, IN SECONDS FROM THE KEY (F): 0 the key is taken and the aim is locked on the nearest of the dead within assist_range tiles and assist_arc_deg of the pointer; 0 to hit_at_s (= windup_s) the wind-up: the weapon comes back, a lunge of lunge_tiles when she was running; swoosh_at_s the whoosh sounds and the trail (`blow`) begins to sweep across the arc and lasts trail_s (the pawn's `thrust` runs 1 to 0 over trail_s from here); hit_at_s THE HIT: the blow lands on every one of the dead in the arc, the nearest in full and the second at second_hit_frac (max_targets at most), the struck one flinches (stagger_s: it neither walks nor bites) and is thrown knockback_tiles back over knockback_s (but never past 0.15 tile inside reach_tiles from her, so that the next swing still reaches it; none for a brute: it is only chipped); then recover_s of recovery; cycle_s = hit_at_s + recover_s is the whole swing and the least time between two. A press of F while the swing runs is kept for buffer_s and starts the next swing the moment this one ends (a press that is older when the swing ends is forgotten). The rules take whole steps of 1/30 s and round each time to the nearest step: the hit lands at 4 steps (0.133 s) and a cycle is 10 steps (0.333 s). THE POSE (what the animation reads): the person's meta `swing_t` (Person.get_meta("swing_t", -1.0)) is the seconds since the key was taken while a swing runs, and -1.0 when none does; the aim is locked until the hit. Draw: wind-up 0 to hit_at_s (the weapon cocked back and up, the body coiled), the strike through hit_at_s (the weapon across the arc, arc_deg wide, reach_tiles long), recovery to cycle_s (the weapon comes back to the carry). THE EFFECT: damage_walker_frac is the share of an average walker's hit points (5.5) that one hit takes (1.1: a walker of 4, 5 or 6 dies at once, one of 7 in two; a runner at once); brute_chip_frac the share of a brute's (26) that one hit takes (0.15: it needs about seven; a plated brute on its plates takes that again by plated.armour, 0.1: melee does nothing to it, it needs the gun's head shots). NOISE (tiles, heard by the dead that stand or wander or sleep there, a few at the most): noise_hit a swing that hurts and does not kill, noise_kill one that kills what it hits (quieter: a body going down), none for a miss. LUNGE: a swing begun while she runs, or within lunge_window_s of running, steps lunge_tiles forward in the wind-up and hits lunge_damage_mult as hard. THE FEEL (render only, none under Reduce motion; Reduce flashes softens the sparkles): hitstop_hit_s / hitstop_kill_s freeze the picture for that many real seconds at a hit and at a kill (hitstop_gap_s the least time between two), camera_kick_px the camera's push along the blow (half as much again at a kill).
